reviews_captured_by_me.text:
Rommy's Kitchen did the remodeling of our kitchen for the prior owners of our house. We recently suffered some water damage and have been trying to get them to bid on a partial rebuild of the island, or at least providing their material suppliers so that another contractor can match the rest of the kitchen.

The person answers the phone is very pleasant, but they have made promises after promises and finally have said they probably won't get to it. So after about 2 months of waiting with our kitchen partially torn up it seems like they are not interested in helping - either by doing the job themselves, or even helping provide their suppliers for matching purposes.

The original work was decent, but don't expect them to stand behind it and support you outside of warranty if you have any issues.

Rommy and his team did a great job with our home improvement project!  He was very responsive and did a nice job of checking in regularly to make sure that the project stayed on track.  During the project, there were a few additional items that I wanted to have done and Rommy was very accommodating.  Rommy worked with my budget and I felt that his prices were fair and honest.  I will definitely be using Rommy and his team again for our next project!
Rommy gave us a wonderful design. The kitchen is superb. He transformed it from an archaic eyesore to a robust gem and magnificent center piece of our home. Quality workmanship well within our budget
